en.name: Lucius II
en.summary: A pope who died from injuries sustained while personally leading an assault against a rebellious Roman commune movement.
en.body: Lucius II confronted a serious challenge from a revived Roman Commune movement, inspired partly by the preaching of Arnold of Brescia, which sought to strip the pope of temporal governing power over the city in favor of a restored civic republic. Lucius personally led an armed assault on the Capitoline stronghold of the commune's supporters and was severely wounded, reportedly by a thrown stone, dying shortly afterward.
